title: The Spiritual Old Age and the Oil of Joy
english: The height and greatness of God is overlooked when the eye of the mind, which is able to approach the Lord, is blinded by evil; and the destruction of sin occurs as if those who have become enemies of God through sinning were to perish, and to perish such are they, but the God who is the victor for all eternity will be found by the purified mind (Ps 91:11-12).

The horn of the kingdom is often an ally and previously was good. Not only shall my horn be exalted like a one-horned beast, but also my old age shall be anointed with the oil of gladness; old age not the bodily one, but the age presenting the perfection of the human soul, for it has been written: for old age is precious, not the long-lived, nor is it measured by number of years, but wisdom is a thing for men and an unblemished life is old age.

Having surpassed this, Abraham was said to be nourished in good old age; for it has been written about him: 'And Abraham died in a good old age, full of days, departing' (Gen 25:8). Regarding the bodily age, if it were said, these things are rather spoken of those who were longer-lived before Abraham.

This is interpreted as old age being anointed with oil, from that true olive tree speaking in the temple of God: 'I am like a fruitful olive tree in the house of God' (Ps 52:8). This olive tree not only anoints the light of knowledge, but also heals and looses pains, anointing the aforementioned old age.

And my eye has looked upon my enemies, and my ear shall hear of those rising up against me, committing iniquity (Ps 17:8). Perhaps the present enemies are cast down by sight, but his ear shall hear concerning those who are to rise up against him. Just as their strength is dissolved, all these things must be expected concerning evil powers. For strictly these are hating us.

And since some transgress the Scripture saying that it sometimes passes by and speaks in vain, let us bear it and let us defend the text also concerning the things set forth. For they say: 'Who does not see what is appearing...'
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
